comments.author: Horszak442
comments.body_html: I know why I couldn’t install it. When you manually move the unpacked folder to the game folder, you have SPT/user/mods/bushtail-SlimmerMagazines/SlimmerMagazines/SlimmerMagazines.dll. Then the server doesn’t see the mod. It should be SPT/user/mods/bushtail-SlimmerMagazines/SlimmerMagazines.dll. I think that one folder inside SlimmerMagazines is unnecessary.
